summary: E2E testing of multi-workspace support (customer-reported invite bug fix). 22/22 backend pytest tests passed and full Playwright frontend flow (signup → invite existing email → multi-workspace login → workspace switcher → JoinWorkspace existing-email branch) passed cleanly. The customer bug ('I sent invitation to my employee, he has registered under his own email for his own workspace. I then sent him invite for my workspace, it says email already exist') is FIXED end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: workspace.py invite_member: When existing user is being re-added to a workspace where they had status='removed', code calls ensure_membership which short-circuits on the existing row (returns it unchanged). Consider explicitly updating status back to 'active' on re-invite of a removed member.

invites.py redeem_invite: For existing email + new workspace, the active workspace is force-switched even if the user was already a member (already_member branch). This is intentional for UX per the comment, but worth noting it overwrites users.workspace_id/role unconditionally.

JoinWorkspace.jsx: When existing_user becomes true, form.name is auto-populated from API but the name field is hidden, so submit sends a name field anyway (harmless because backend ignores it for existing users). Minor cleanliness issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-workspace feature is solid. Bug fix verified: POST /api/workspace/invite with existing-user email returns 200 with added_to_existing_user=true; existing user keeps their original workspace and gains a workspace_members row in the inviter's workspace. /api/me/workspaces, /api/workspace/switch, /api/public/invite/check-email, and existing-email redeem branch all work. Sidebar workspace switcher and JoinWorkspace existing-email banner UI work as specified. All workspaces[] arrays returned by /auth/signup, /auth/login, /auth/demo-login, /auth/me. Regression checks on /workspace/members, /admin/overview, /admin/users, /dashboard, /chats, /tasks, /invites/suggestions, /invites all pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA: /api/workspace/invite did `existing = db.users.find_one({email})` and raised HTTPException(400, 'User already exists') if found. This made a user who self-signed-up uninvitable. Fix (verified): if user exists, call ensure_membership(existing_user_id, current_workspace_id, role) to insert a workspace_members row (idempotent), keeping the user's original workspace_id pointer intact. Multi-workspace membership is now sourced from the workspace_members collection rather than the single users.workspace_id pointer.
